About

The man behind
the energy.

LA Vibes, professionally known as Olaoluwa Oyewo, is a Nigerian MC, Hypeman and Event Host passionate about creating unforgettable experiences through energy, personality, crowd engagement and professional event management.

With the ability to adapt to different audiences and environments, LA Vibes brings a distinctive blend of entertainment, confidence and professionalism to every event — from corporate gatherings and brand activations to weddings, concerts, parties and nightlife experiences. He understands how to read the room, connect with the audience and deliver the right energy for every occasion.

Beyond entertainment, Olaoluwa is also a qualified Nigerian lawyer, bringing the communication skills, composure and professional discipline of the corporate world into the entertainment space.

Case Study 01
ICS Outsourcing Nigeria Limited — End of Year Party

The event was a celebration marking the close of a successful work calendar, thoughtfully themed around the rich cultural concept of Ojude Oba. With employees transitioning from their professional work environment into a relaxed, celebratory atmosphere, the event required the right blend of energy, engagement and entertainment to set the tone. LA Vibes brought exactly that — connecting with employees and seamlessly transforming the room from work mode to party mode.

Case Study 02
Eko in the Garden City

The NBA Annual General Conference was held in Port Harcourt, bringing together lawyers from across Nigeria. In celebration, the NBA Lagos Branch hosted a special party dedicated to its members and to the profession. With a room full of accomplished professionals ready to unwind, LA Vibes brought the balance of energy, entertainment and crowd engagement that turned the celebration into an unforgettable night.

Case Study 03
Boat Cruise x Dinner Date with Luscious Brand

Luscious Brand operates within the catering and food industry, creating memorable culinary experiences for its customers, including games nights, dinner events and boat cruises. These experiences require more than entertainment — they require a host who can combine coordination, professionalism, personality and audience engagement. LA Vibes brought that combination, keeping the atmosphere lively from start to finish.
